posts.title: Vote to demote!
posts.html: Sometimes on RP servers you have a Vote Demote. Say the renegade leader or mayor have been afk for about 10 minutes or aren't doing their job. You would type /demote (Slacker's name) (reason) And a demotion vote would pop up. People would type something like /voteyes and it would vote yes. But atleast 8 people have to vote yes so no minge comes and demotes everyone. Also there should be a time limit of 15 seconds for the vote to go on. People would also type /voteno to vote no to the vote. Or use something easier like /vno or /vyes
